_comment: Overlay of esp-brookesia's shell portrait constants for the Waveshare
ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8 V2 (368x448).
THE RULE THIS FILE EXISTS TO OBEY: on this build there is no FreeType and
no TinyTTF (CONFIG_LV_USE_FREETYPE / CONFIG_LV_USE_TINY_TTF are both off,
so the TTFs under /system/fonts are never loaded). Every glyph comes from
a built-in LVGL Montserrat, and gui/brookesia_gui_lvgl/src/style_font.cpp
get_builtin_font() returns an exact size match or else the closest SMALLER
compiled face. The compiled ladder in this project's sdkconfig is:
A size off that ladder does not scale -- it silently rounds DOWN to the
next rung. Upstream's 11sp status text has nothing below it but Montserrat
8, so the clock and the WiFi pill were rendering at EIGHT pixels. That is
the whole of 'the top battery bar and time is not legible'; it was never an
11px problem. Likewise 14sp rendered at 12, and 15sp -- the floor
uikit/tokens.json calls hard -- also rendered at 12.
So: every font size in this file is a ladder rung. Do not invent one.
Deltas from upstream, and why each one moved:
statusPillFont   11sp -> 16sp   was rendering at 8px
statusClockFont  11sp -> 16sp   was rendering at 8px
captionFont      14sp -> 16sp   launcher app labels, were at 12px
bodyFont         13sp -> 16sp   was at 12px
sectionTitleFont 13sp -> 16sp   was at 12px
titleFont        22sp -> 24sp   was at 20px
debugTitleFont/debugTextFont 10sp -> 12sp   were at 8px
statusPillHeight 22dp -> 26dp   16px text needs ~21px of line box
statusPillWidth  54dp -> 62dp   'WiFi' at 16px no longer fits 54
statusClockWidth 54dp -> 62dp   '00:00' at 16px no longer fits 54
statusPaddingY    5dp ->  3dp   buys the taller pill its room inside a
36dp bar WITHOUT moving topBarHeight,
which statusBarCollapsedY and content.y
are both pinned to.
launcherIconTileSize/IconSize 92dp -> 86dp
launcherTitleBoxHeight        16dp -> 22dp
a 16px label needs a ~21px box. The tile
is a centred flex column whose height is
pinned at 112 by LAUNCHER_ITEM_HEIGHT in
shell_app_launcher.cpp, so the icon gives
back exactly what the label takes:
86 + 4 (labelGap) + 22 = 112. 86dp is
still well over the 76dp touch floor.
DO NOT change launcherItemWidth/Height/Gap here. shell_app_launcher.cpp
hardcodes LAUNCHER_ITEM_WIDTH/HEIGHT = 112 and LAUNCHER_ITEM_GAP = 18 and
computes every tile's x/y from those constants, while the tile RENDERS at
the size this file declares. They are two independent sources of truth and
they only agree by coincidence -- change one and the grid comes apart.
